scope: Read-only targeted diagnosis of the seven unresolved D271 forced-known-stop intervals. No production edits, build, native probe, test, national regeneration or delegation. Candidate manifests are proposals only.

diagnosis.north: PSW has a genuine original station marker and explicit own 成昆 relation membership, but is absent from published station features. Relation10286390v190 is withheld by compile_route because no relation operator/network is tagged and its exact original ways carry two distinct Chengdu/Kunming operating agencies. Its north Chengdu-only mainline is usable without assigning an operator to the entire relation. CNW existing 成贵 branch anchor is a different original track; retain it and add an independently evidenced own 成昆 station binding.
diagnosis.south: All five missing interval paths exist in the active original Eguang relation10259709v159. Existing sourceStations already bind all endpoints. continuous_chains falls back to separately chosen consecutive intervals; those choices alternate between physically disjoint parallel source strands. The published sourceIntervals omit the needed continuation of the other strand. Original missing runs attach at exact existing source vertices; no proximity node merge is needed.
diagnosis.strictStrandCaution: Pairwise shortest missing-edge repairs alternate original track strands. Recommended common-strand candidates instead keep the exact station anchor sequence CNW5617675902→PSW10779177796→XCE10244648816→DXE12960690113→MDE11164531496→YBE12960653373→PNE5230617665. No graph edge joins opposite station anchors.
diagnosis.remainingWholeJourneyLimit: The pinned Eguang relation alone has six original-node components. Its original northern strand at PNE5230617665 and existing PNE→Yuanmou southern strand at PNE14072871990 lie in different components. This review does not establish a single continuous original-node D271 path across Panzhihua South, or from Guangtong North to the published Guangkun strand. Do not promote station identity equivalence into an invented track connection or claim a native/runtime result.

staticOriginalAdjacencyProof.description: Every proposed edge was checked as consecutive nodes of the version-pinned original member way. Adding the candidates to existing published Eguang sourceIntervals yields the exact through strand from own CNW source stop to PNE5230617665. This verifies source adjacency only, not native solver behavior or exact D271 platform assignment.

builderPath.operatorWithholding: compile_route gathers exact member_operators; if two distinct bureau names exist, none is selected and no network fallback exists on10286390. Whole relation is withheld.
builderPath.stationBinding: ChinaBuilder.stations: exact original route marker membership precedes bounded projection to nodes of that own relation; nonurban bound1500m. Binding does not create graph edges.
builderPath.intervalSelection: ChinaBuilder.ordered_chains→continuous_chains→choose_ordered_anchors; full platform chain can fail, causing independently selected original intervals. Only chosen sourceIntervals are published.
builderPath.physicalImport: app/scripts/railway/build-china-physical-junctions.py:compile_reviewed_physical_sections validates exact relation inventory, node/way versions, original adjacency, operator evidence and passenger corridor evidence.
builderPath.stationPublicationGap: Existing physical manifest import creates N02 rail features only; it does not create passenger station features. PSW and own-line CNW/XCE binding additions require an explicit reviewed original-station binding implementation/decision by parent; no fake station or alteration of existing anchors is proposed.
